```{r}

library(haven)       # read/write Stata .dta files
library(tidyverse)   # dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, stringr, etc.
library(sandwich)    # vcovCL for clustered standard errors
library(lmtest)      # coeftest to display results with robust SEs

# Binscatter helper
binscatter_data <- function(data, xvar, yvar, groupvar = NULL, nbins = 20) {
  cols <- c(x = xvar, y = yvar)
  if (!is.null(groupvar)) cols <- c(cols, group = groupvar)
  df <- data %>%
    select(all_of(cols)) %>%
    drop_na(x, y)

  if (!is.null(groupvar)) {
    df <- df %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      mutate(bin = ntile(x, nbins)) %>%
      group_by(group, bin) %>%
      summarise(x = mean(x), y = mean(y), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(bin = ntile(x, nbins)) %>%
      group_by(bin) %>%
      summarise(x = mean(x), y = mean(y), .groups = "drop")
  }
  df
}


# PART 1 — Build AIOE scores for each sample

samples <- c("binary_all", "only_generatingimages", "only_languagemodeling")

sample_results <- list()  # store intermediate results

for (sample in samples) {

  
  app_var <- read_dta("../Data/Source data/AIOE and AIIE source files/application_variations.dta")

  app_var <- app_var %>%
    select(applications, all_of(sample)) %>%
    rename(score = !!sample)

  mturk <- read_dta("../Data/Source data/AIOE and AIIE source files/mturk_mapping_matrix.dta")
  merged <- app_var %>%
    left_join(mturk, by = "applications")

  ability_cols <- setdiff(names(mturk), "applications")

  merged <- merged %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(ability_cols), ~ score * .x))

  mat <- merged %>%
    select(all_of(ability_cols)) %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame()

  mat$onet_element <- rownames(mat)
  rownames(mat) <- NULL

  v_cols <- setdiff(names(mat), "onet_element")
  mat$onet_score <- rowSums(mat[, v_cols], na.rm = TRUE)

  onet_scores <- mat %>% select(onet_element, onet_score)

  # Load O*NET abilities data 
  abilities <- read_dta("../Data/Source data/AIOE and AIIE source files/abilities_2020.dta")

  # Standardising element name to match
  abilities <- abilities %>%
    rename(onet_element = elementname) %>%
    mutate(onet_element = str_to_lower(onet_element),
           onet_element = str_replace_all(onet_element, "[ -]", ""))

  # Creating scaled scores 
  abilities <- abilities %>%
    mutate(
      scale_importance = if_else(scaleid == "IM", datavalue / 5, NA_real_),
      scale_level      = if_else(scaleid == "LV", datavalue / 7, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    group_by(onetsoccode, elementid) %>%
    mutate(
      level_scaled      = max(scale_level,      na.rm = TRUE),
      importance_scaled  = max(scale_importance, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(scalar = level_scaled * importance_scaled)

  abilities <- abilities %>%
    select(onetsoccode, onet_element, importance_scaled, level_scaled, scalar) %>%
    distinct()

  # Occupation-level base sums 
  abilities <- abilities %>%
    group_by(onetsoccode) %>%
    mutate(
      ability_base    = sum(scalar,            na.rm = TRUE),
      importance_base = sum(importance_scaled,  na.rm = TRUE),
      level_base      = sum(level_scaled,       na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

 
  abilities <- abilities %>%
    left_join(onet_scores, by = "onet_element")

  abilities <- abilities %>%
    mutate(
      wtd_element_impact     = scalar            * onet_score,
      imp_wtd_element_impact = importance_scaled  * onet_score,
      lvl_element_impact     = level_scaled       * onet_score
    )

  # Sum by occupation 
  abilities <- abilities %>%
    group_by(onetsoccode) %>%
    mutate(
      total_weighted_impact = sum(wtd_element_impact,     na.rm = TRUE),
      imp_weighted_impact   = sum(imp_wtd_element_impact, na.rm = TRUE),
      lvl_weighted_impact   = sum(lvl_element_impact,     na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

 
  occ_data <- abilities %>%
    select(onetsoccode, ability_base, importance_base, level_base,
           total_weighted_impact, imp_weighted_impact, lvl_weighted_impact) %>%
    distinct()

  # Map to BLS SOC codes 
  occ_data <- occ_data %>%
    mutate(onet_soc_map = str_sub(onetsoccode, 1, 7))

  occ_data <- occ_data %>%
    group_by(onet_soc_map) %>%
    mutate(
      avg_wtd_impact      = mean(total_weighted_impact, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_imp_wtd_impact  = mean(imp_weighted_impact,   na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_lvl_wtd_impact  = mean(lvl_weighted_impact,   na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_ability_base    = mean(ability_base,           na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_importance_base = mean(importance_base,        na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_level_base      = mean(level_base,             na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  occ_data <- occ_data %>%
    select(onet_soc_map, avg_wtd_impact, avg_imp_wtd_impact, avg_lvl_wtd_impact,
           avg_ability_base, avg_importance_base, avg_level_base) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(ability_base_impact = avg_wtd_impact / avg_ability_base)


  occ_data <- occ_data %>%
    rename(occ_code = onet_soc_map)

  occ_titles <- read_dta("../Data/Source data/AIOE and AIIE source files/occ_title_2020.dta")
  occ_data <- occ_data %>%
    inner_join(occ_titles, by = "occ_code")

  aioe_col <- paste0(sample, "_aioe")
  raw_col  <- paste0("raw_", sample, "_aioe")

  occ_data <- occ_data %>%
    mutate(
      !!raw_col  := ability_base_impact,
      !!aioe_col := as.numeric(scale(ability_base_impact))
    )

  sample_results[[sample]] <- occ_data
}

# PART 2 — Combining the three samples


combined <- sample_results[["binary_all"]]

for (sample in c("only_languagemodeling", "only_generatingimages")) {
  cols_to_add <- sample_results[[sample]] %>%
    select(occ_code,
           ends_with("_aioe"),
           starts_with("raw_"))
  cols_to_add <- cols_to_add %>%
    select(occ_code, contains(sample))
  combined <- combined %>%
    left_join(cols_to_add, by = "occ_code")
}

combined <- combined %>%
  select(-avg_wtd_impact, -avg_imp_wtd_impact, -avg_lvl_wtd_impact,
         -avg_importance_base, -avg_level_base)

combined <- combined %>%
  rename(
    aggregate_aioe = binary_all_aioe,
    lm_aioe        = only_languagemodeling_aioe,
    ig_aioe        = only_generatingimages_aioe,
    raw_lm_aioe    = raw_only_languagemodeling_aioe,
    raw_ig_aioe    = raw_only_generatingimages_aioe
  )

# Save
write_dta(combined, "../Data/Intermediate data/generative_ai_aioe.dta")

# PART 3 (PANEL VERSION) — Build year-varying GenAI AIIE
#
# Changes from the cross-section version:
#   - Uses oes
#   - Employment shares are computed WITHIN (naics, year) cells, so the
#     occupational mix used to weight AIOE -> AIIE varies across years
#   - Aggregation is done by (naics, naics_title, year)
#   - Standardisation is POOLED across the full panel (single mean / SD)
#     so within-industry time variation survives. Do NOT z-score within year
#     unless you want to wipe out the very variation FE regressions exploit.


library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)

gen_ai_aioe <- read_dta("../Data/Intermediate data/generative_ai_aioe.dta") %>%
  select(occ_code, aggregate_aioe, lm_aioe, ig_aioe)


oes_panel <- read_csv(
  "../Data/Intermediate data/oes_panel_2016_2024.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    year        = col_integer(),
    naics       = col_character(),
    naics_title = col_character(),
    occ_code    = col_character(),
    occ_title   = col_character(),
    tot_emp     = col_double(),
    o_group     = col_character(),
    i_group     = col_character()
  )
) %>%
  filter(o_group == "detailed") %>%
  select(year, naics, naics_title, occ_code, tot_emp)


oes_merged <- oes_panel %>%
  inner_join(gen_ai_aioe, by = "occ_code") %>%
  group_by(year, naics) %>%
  mutate(
    naics_emp       = sum(tot_emp, na.rm = TRUE),
    naics_emp_share = tot_emp / naics_emp
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(is.finite(naics_emp_share))

# Employment-weighted aggregation AIOE -> AIIE per (naics, year) 
aiie_panel <- oes_merged %>%
  mutate(
    aggregate_contrib = aggregate_aioe * naics_emp_share,
    lm_contrib        = lm_aioe        * naics_emp_share,
    ig_contrib        = ig_aioe        * naics_emp_share
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, naics, naics_title) %>%
  summarise(
    aggregate_raw_aiie = sum(aggregate_contrib, na.rm = TRUE),
    lm_raw_aiie        = sum(lm_contrib,        na.rm = TRUE),
    ig_raw_aiie        = sum(ig_contrib,        na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 5. Pooled z-score standardisation across the full panel
aiie_panel <- aiie_panel %>%
  mutate(
    aggregate_aiie = as.numeric(scale(aggregate_raw_aiie)),
    lm_aiie        = as.numeric(scale(lm_raw_aiie)),
    ig_aiie        = as.numeric(scale(ig_raw_aiie))
  )

 
# Pad panel with zero rows for pre-2016 years
naics_lookup <- aiie_panel %>%
  distinct(naics, naics_title) %>%
  group_by(naics) %>%
  slice(1) %>%   
  ungroup()
 
pad_years <- 1997:2015
zero_rows <- naics_lookup %>%
  crossing(year = pad_years) %>%
  mutate(
    aggregate_raw_aiie = 0,
    lm_raw_aiie        = 0,
    ig_raw_aiie        = 0,
    aggregate_aiie     = 0,
    lm_aiie            = 0,
    ig_aiie            = 0
  )
 
aiie_panel <- bind_rows(aiie_panel, zero_rows) %>%
  arrange(naics, year)

# Save full NAICS-level panel 
write_dta(aiie_panel, "../Data/Intermediate data/generative_ai_aiie_panel.dta")
write_csv(aiie_panel, "../Data/Intermediate data/generative_ai_aiie_panel.csv")

# Build a 4-digit merge-ready panel version 

aiie_merge_panel <- aiie_panel %>%
  mutate(naics4 = as.numeric(substr(naics, 1, 4))) %>%
  group_by(year, naics4) %>%
  mutate(check = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(check <= 1) %>%
  select(-check)

write_dta(aiie_merge_panel, "../Data/Intermediate data/generative_ai_aiie_panel_merge.dta")
write_csv(aiie_merge_panel, "../Data/Intermediate data/generative_ai_aiie_panel_merge.csv")

# 8. Diagnostics 
cat("\n=== Panel coverage (rows per year) ===\n")
print(aiie_panel %>% count(year))

cat("\n=== AIIE summary (pooled z-scores) ===\n")
print(summary(aiie_panel %>% select(aggregate_aiie, lm_aiie, ig_aiie)))

cat("\n=== Within-industry SD of AIIE (across years) ===\n")

within_sd <- aiie_panel %>%
  group_by(naics, naics_title) %>%
  summarise(
    sd_aggregate = sd(aggregate_aiie),
    sd_lm        = sd(lm_aiie),
    sd_ig        = sd(ig_aiie),
    n_years      = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_years > 1)
cat("Mean within-industry SD across measures:\n")
print(within_sd %>% summarise(across(starts_with("sd_"), mean, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat("\n(If these are very small, the AIIE barely moves within an industry —\n",
    " expected here because AIOE is still pinned to abilities_2020. Adding\n",
    " year-varying abilities will widen this.)\n", sep = "")

cat("\n=== Top 10 (industry, year) cells by Language Modeling AIIE ===\n")
aiie_panel %>%
  arrange(desc(lm_aiie)) %>%
  select(year, naics, naics_title, lm_aiie) %>%
  head(10) %>% print()

cat("\n=== Correlation between AIIE variants (panel-pooled) ===\n")
print(cor(aiie_panel %>% select(aggregate_aiie, lm_aiie, ig_aiie),
          use = "complete.obs"))



# Summary statistics 
cat("\n=== Summary: raw_lm_aioe ===\n")
summary(combined$raw_lm_aioe)
cat("SD:", sd(combined$raw_lm_aioe, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\n=== Summary: raw_ig_aioe ===\n")
summary(combined$raw_ig_aioe)
cat("SD:", sd(combined$raw_ig_aioe, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\n=== Paired t-test: raw_lm_aioe vs raw_ig_aioe ===\n")
print(t.test(combined$raw_lm_aioe, combined$raw_ig_aioe, paired = TRUE))

plot_demographic <- function(data, xvar, xlabel, nbins = 20) {
  bs <- binscatter_data(data, xvar, "aioe", "application", nbins)
  ggplot(bs, aes(x = x, y = y, color = group, shape = group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Language Modeling AIOE" = "navy",
                                  "Image Generation AIOE" = "steelblue")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Language Modeling AIOE" = 16,
                                  "Image Generation AIOE" = 18)) +
    labs(x = xlabel, y = "Exposure to Generative AI",
         color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_demographic(fig2_long, "mean_male",     "Percent Male Employment")
plot_demographic(fig2_long, "mean_female",   "Percent Female Employment")
plot_demographic(fig2_long, "mean_white",    "Percent White Employment")
plot_demographic(fig2_long, "mean_black",    "Percent Black Employment")

plot_demographic(fig2_long, "mean_hispanic", "Percent Hispanic Employment")

# SUPPLEMENTARY — Regression Analysis 
gen_ai4 <- read_dta("../Data/Intermediate data/generative_ai_aioe.dta")

salary <- read_dta("../Data/Source data/AIOE and AIIE source files/occ_salary_data_2021.dta")
gen_ai4 <- gen_ai4 %>% inner_join(salary, by = "occ_code")

education <- read_dta("../Data/Source data/AIOE and AIIE source files/occ_required_education.dta")
gen_ai4 <- gen_ai4 %>% left_join(education, by = "occ_code")

creative <- read_dta("../Data/Source data/AIOE and AIIE source files/occ_creative_weight.dta")
gen_ai4 <- gen_ai4 %>% left_join(creative, by = "occ_code")

gen_ai4 <- gen_ai4 %>%
  mutate(broad_category = as.factor(str_sub(occ_code, 1, 2)))

# Supplemental Table 1: LM regressions 
dep_vars_1 <- c("median_salary_2021", "occ_req_education", "avg_creative_weight")

sup_table1 <- list()

for (dv in dep_vars_1) {
  fml <- as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ lm_aioe + avg_ability_base + broad_category"))
  mod <- lm(fml, data = gen_ai4)
  ct  <- coeftest(mod, vcov = vcovCL(mod, cluster = gen_ai4$occ_code))
  sup_table1[[paste0(dv, "_lm")]] <- ct
}

for (dv in dep_vars_1) {
  fml <- as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ ig_aioe + avg_ability_base + broad_category"))
  mod <- lm(fml, data = gen_ai4)
  ct  <- coeftest(mod, vcov = vcovCL(mod, cluster = gen_ai4$occ_code))
  sup_table1[[paste0(dv, "_ig")]] <- ct
}

# Print Supplemental Table 1
cat("\n========== SUPPLEMENTAL TABLE 1 ==========\n")
for (nm in names(sup_table1)) {
  cat("\n---", nm, "---\n")
  print(sup_table1[[nm]])
}

}

for (dv in dep_vars_2) {

  mod <- lm(fml, data = gen_ai5)
```
